title: Convert an XLSForm to a Word or PDF Document
text: Front matter: form title, version form ID, language, date generation, legend explains marks used document. Groups: headings numbered depth. Repeat groups carry “Repeat …” line describes repeat count. Questions: number label, * required questions, hint italics, variable name show_variable_names = TRUE. “Ask ” “Constraint” lines follow answer area. Single choice (select_one): hollow circle choice. Lists seven fewer choices print one column; longer lists print columns. Multiple choice (select_multiple): hollow square choice. Rank: box beside choice write rank. Long choice lists: list longer max_choices, paper form shows code box respondent write code, compact table every choice code. Text numbers: bordered write-box. Multiline text gets taller box. Date time: printed pattern (dd/mm/yyyy, hh:mm). Location: latitude, longitude accuracy fields geopoint. geotrace geoshape get prompt reference line. Media: image printed size, scaled fit (questions 2 inches tall, choices 0.6 inches). missing file prints placeholder name, convertxlsform warns . Notes: printed without number. Hidden types (calculate, start, end, deviceid similar) left unless include_hidden = TRUE.

title: Convert an XLSForm from the terminal — cli
text: cli(args): form.xlsx [options]. Options accept --name value --name=value. -o, --output PATH: output file folder (default: next form). -f, --format docx|pdf|: output format (default: extension --output, else docx). -l, --lang LANG: language code, name header suffix. --flat-numbers: number questions 1, 2, 3 instead 1.1, 1.2. ---relevants: hide skip logic. ---constraints: hide constraints. ---hints: hide hints. ---choice-codes: hide choice codes. --show-names: show variable names. --include-hidden: include calculate, start, end similar rows. --media-root DIR: folder media external files (default: folder form). --title TEXT: form title. --page-size A4|letter (default A4). --landscape: landscape orientation. --margins : margins inches (default 1). --font NAME (default Arial) --font-size PT (default 11). --template FILE: reference .docx styles. --max-choices N: longest choice list printed full (default 30). --repeat-copies N: copies repeat group (default 1). --overwrite: replace existing output. --quiet: progress messages. -h, --help: show help stop. --version: show package version stop.

title: convertxlsform 0.3.0
text: convertxlsform() writes Word document (.docx) default. format = "pdf" format = c("docx", "pdf") also writes PDF. output location, format overwrite rules follow arguments, function returns paths invisibly. PDF output converts Word document LibreOffice. Microsoft Word used doconv package LibreOffice found. docx_to_pdf() has_libreoffice() exported. cli() runs conversion terminal, example Rscript -e 'convertxlsform::cli()' form.xlsx --format pdf. Scripts can use quit(status = convertxlsform::cli()) get exit status. xlsform_outline() returns numbered form data frame, checking form conversion. xlsform_languages() lists languages form marks default. Language columns read label::English (en), label::en label::English. lang argument accepts code, name full suffix. blank translated cell falls back plain column, default language. Headers common language name , label::French, also match ISO 639-1 code (lang = "fr"). Skip logic, constraints choice filters written plain language. Expressions read shown written. Connective phrases “Ask ” come built-English French tables. strings option replaces another language. Paper layouts question type: single multiple choice, rank, long lists code boxes, write-boxes, numeric, date time formats, geographic media questions, acknowledgments. Groups repeat groups, nested numbering (nested_serial_numbers) blank copies repeats (repeat_copies). Question images scaled 2 inches tall, choice images 0.6 inches. missing media choice file triggers one combined warning, missing image prints placeholder. Complex-script fonts chosen text Bengali, Arabic, Devanagari Ethiopic. font_family_cs option overrides choice. Page size, orientation, margins (2 inches), fonts, reference template, title, switches hints, constraints, relevants, choice codes, variable names hidden rows. Bundled examples: inst/extdata/multilang (multilingual, external choice list images) inst/extdata/all_types (every question type feature package renders).
